name: Electrochemistry of Materials
summary: Provides the electrochemical thermodynamics and kinetics needed for corrosion, batteries, fuel cells, electroplating and extractive metallurgy.

topics.name: Redox reactions, half-cells and electrochemical cells
Electrode potentials, the standard hydrogen electrode and the electrochemical series
The Nernst equation and concentration effects
Electrode kinetics: exchange current density and the Butler-Volmer equation
Overpotentials: activation, concentration and ohmic; Tafel analysis
Mass transport: diffusion, migration and convection; limiting current
Electrolytes: aqueous, molten salt, polymer and solid ionic conductors
The electrical double layer and capacitance
Electrochemical techniques: cyclic voltammetry, potentiodynamic polarisation, impedance spectroscopy
